props.name: children
props.comment: Child field(s) rendered against the referenced record.

props.name: empty
props.comment: Rendered when no related record exists. A string is translated.

props.name: error
props.comment: Rendered when the reference lookup errors.

props.name: filter
props.comment: Permanent filter merged into the reference lookup. Read when the record id changes; remount with a `key` to change it otherwise.

props.name: loading
props.comment: Rendered while the referenced record is loading.

props.name: record
props.comment: The record whose id is matched. Defaults to the ambient record.

props.name: reference
props.comment: The referenced resource holding the one-to-one record (e.g. `"bios"`).

props.name: render
props.comment:
Render-prop alternative to `children`: receives the resolved referenced
record (or `undefined` while loading / on error).

props.name: sort
props.comment: Sort applied to the reference lookup (the first match is used). Read when the record id changes; remount with a `key` to change it otherwise.

props.name: source
props.comment: The field on the current record the `target` matches. Default `"id"`.

props.name: target
props.comment: The FK field on the reference pointing back at this record (e.g. `"author_id"`). A key of the referenced resource's record.
